message: Since there was still time until the next match, I decided to take a walk outside the arena to clear my head.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「...Are you sure it’s okay to go out when you have a match coming up next?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Well, as long as I’m back before it starts, it’ll be fine!」
Victoria-senpai’s first match is over, and mine is the second.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Honestly, don't you have all sorts of things you need to prepare？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「If it’s just changing and getting set up, I don’t even need ten minutes, right？ I think this is better than sitting over there, wound up and nervous.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Well, if you say that will lead to a better result, I suppose I don’t mind, but...」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「It will~, it’ll definitely lead to a better result~!」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「*Sigh*... Muragaki-san has his hands full with you, doesn't he.」
Kei-chan knit her brows in exasperation.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...Hey, Kei-chan.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「What is it?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「The other day, you asked Muragaki-sensei if he would become your personal coach, didn't you?」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「...Did you happen to overhear that？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yeah, sorry. I was just curious.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「It’s fine. I thought I would have to explain it to you eventually anyway.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「However, let’s drop the subject for now. I want you to focus on the match right in front of you.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yeah, actually, that’s exactly why I wanted to tell you now—to help me focus.」
I turned to face Kei-chan.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Look, Kei-chan... I’m going to become a Toujinegi.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I’ll definitely win this Martial Festival and become a Toujinegi.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「So... I want you to turn down the request from the family head.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You want to become the head of the Kazamine family, right？ If so, I’ll make you the head.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「If I beat the Suzakuin and become a Toujinegi, you’ll definitely be able to become the head without having to accept that request from the family head.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That’s why, I don’t want you to go overseas.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「……I’m surprised. I never expected to hear those words from you.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「……Disappointed in me？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「No, you’re certainly right.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「If you were to earn the title of Toujinegi and nominate me as head of the family, then there is no doubt I would be closer to that position.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「But I didn't want to force that upon you.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Of course, you and I are one and the same. I assumed you would help me even without me having to say it.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「But… I didn’t want to make you carry that burden.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yeah, I kinda thought that might be it.」
Kei-chan never forced anything on me. She always encouraged me to think things through with her and reach our own answer.
I’m the only one who truly knows that kindness of Kei-chan’s.
I think that’s why she was worried about whether or not to take on the head of the family's request.
Becoming the Toujinegi is impossible unless I give it my all, but the head of the family's request is something I can accomplish on my own.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I’m going to win this Martial Festival and become the Toujinegi.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「So, Kei-chan, promise me. If I can become the Toujinegi, you won't go overseas.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「……Why are you trying to keep me here？」
Kei-chan looks troubled.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Isn't that obvious!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Because！ Kei-chan is a student in the Takamura Class too！ Everyone would be so lonely if you left！」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「……I see, so that’s it.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「It seems you’ve been quite corrupted by Muragaki-san’s educational philosophy, too.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Don’t say 'corrupted'~! I think it’s actually really great.」
I want to stay with everyone in the Takamura Class, and with Muragaki-sensei, until we graduate, without a single person missing.
I’ll work as hard as I can to make that happen.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh, that’s right. I have a side request, too.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I was wondering if you could fudge things a bit so Sensei can keep doing his ‘errands’ until we graduate~」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「That’s a pretty heavy request for a ‘side note’.」
Kei-chan gives a bitter smile.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「But… I have certainly received your resolve, Setsugekka.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「If you insist, I’ll see what I can do.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「R-really！？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Though, the request from Makinojou-san is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「If we’re going to trade this for that, it wouldn’t be a fair deal unless what you offer is of equal value.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「In other words, you’re saying I absolutely have to become the Toujinegi, right？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Yes, that’s exactly what I mean.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Leave it to me！ I’ll absolutely, positively win！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「All right, I’m fired up now！」
Ah, I’m glad I spoke with her before the main matches began. Now I can face the tournament without a single worry—！

name: Keisetsu
message: 「…It’s about time.」
After checking the time briefly on a hologram, Kei-chan looked me straight in the eye.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Setsugekka, I’ve been watching you by your side all the way until today.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「You have masterfully wielded the secret art of Tamukai. And you proved that strength in the qualifiers.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Be proud, Setsugekka. Within the Kazamine family, you are the strongest swordsman there ever was or ever will be.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「To all the martial families, and to every single person—show them that a Kazamine swordsman is here…！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yeah… thank you, Kei-chan！ I’m going now！！」
Bidding Kei-chan farewell, I dashed toward the arena.
